title: Observation
description: A single typed engineering observation captured into the brain at the moment it happens. v0.6, iterating.

type.description: The kind of observation. See suraya.ai/schema for the meaning of each.

actor_handle.description: GitHub handle of the operator capturing. Optional for system-emitted observations.

machine_id.description: Stable identifier for the machine this observation was captured from.

session_id.description: Session identifier when applicable (a coherent unit of work).

project_slug.description: Project this observation attributes to. Required for project-scoped retrieval.

scope_id.description: Optional binding to a scopes table entry (T1.7 bridge).

captured_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the observation was captured.

validity_start.description: Optional. The earliest time this observation describes (default: captured_at).

validity_end.description: Optional. When this observation stops applying (e.g. a corrected decision).

linked_observation_ids.description: Other observations this one links to. E.g. a 'fix' linking back to its 'failure'.

affected_production.description: Did this observation describe a change that hit production?
